youtube_description:
Ono CEO and Founder Interviewed by former Bloomberg TV Editor
Ono Academic College’s CEO and founder, Ranan Hartman, was recently interviewed by Elliott Gotkine, Bloomberg Television's former editor. Among other topics, they covered:
• Hartman’s relationship with his father, the renowned Rabbi David Hartman
• Demonstrating the Importance of Higher Education to Underserved Communities in Israel
• Ensuring that Ethiopian Jews Studying at Ono Become Role Models in the Community
• Making Israeli Palestinian Arabs Feel Equal in Israel
• Building Israel’s First Multicultural Campus at Savyon Junction
• Having Israel’s Best Instructors for the Past 5 Years
• Closing Educational Gaps While Ensuring High Quality Teaching
• Making Sure that Every Student, Including Those with Differing Abilities, Feels at Home
• Applying Ono’s Multicultural Experience to All of Israeli Society
• Ono’s Future Focus on Technology and Medicine
